# White Rabbit LA

> White Rabbit delivers bespoke magical experiences for Fortune 500 events, private celebrations, and luxury gatherings. Based in Los Angeles, led by magician Scott Syme.

## About

White Rabbit LA is a luxury magic entertainment company founded and led by Scott Syme, a Los Angeles-based magician and member of the Academy of Magical Arts at the Magic Castle in Hollywood. Scott specializes in close-up magic, mentalism, and parlor shows for high-end corporate events, weddings, private parties, and brand activations. He is a former luxury real estate professional at Compass Beverly Hills, bringing white-glove hospitality to every performance. 5-star rated across 50 reviews.

## Notable Credits

- Featured performer on America's Got Talent (NBC)
- Magic consultant for Disney Channel (Bizaardvark)
- Consultant to America's Got Talent champion Dustin Tavella
- Member, Academy of Magical Arts (Magic Castle, Hollywood)
- Member, International Brotherhood of Magicians

## Services

- Corporate Event Magician: Fortune 500 galas, product launches, holiday parties, executive retreats
- Wedding Magician: Cocktail hour, reception, rehearsal dinner entertainment
- Private Party Magician: Birthday celebrations, dinner parties, house parties
- Close-Up Magician: Strolling table-side magic and mentalism
- Private Magic Show: Intimate parlor-style performances for groups of 10-80
- Trade Show Magician: Booth traffic, lead generation, brand activations
- Golf Tournament Magician: On-course and clubhouse entertainment
- Holiday Party Magician: Christmas parties, New Year's Eve, Halloween events
- Charity Gala Magician: Fundraiser and nonprofit event entertainment
- DMC Entertainment: Destination management company partnerships
- Resident Event Magician: HOA and residential community entertainment

## Service Areas

Primary: Los Angeles, Beverly Hills, Hollywood, Santa Monica, Malibu, West Hollywood, Bel Air, Pasadena, Calabasas, Pacific Palisades

Also serving: New York, Miami, Las Vegas, San Francisco, Chicago, Dallas, Austin, Nashville, Scottsdale, Aspen, The Hamptons, Greenwich, Palm Beach, Nantucket, Martha's Vineyard, and 80+ additional cities nationwide.
